summary: Steel tower on Quaker Hill, Portsmouth: CCC construction from 1934, first operated 1937, removed 1963 to Tiverton. No source describes the Portsmouth site today.

corrections.proposed: State Division of Forests and Parks (State Department of Agriculture)
corrections.why: Sub appears to be cut from the district label 'Newport County - Sub-District A' on the Forest Lookouts page. That label names a district, not an agency. The 1950 notice on the same page names the state division as the operator.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1934 report describes a 60-foot steel stairway and cabin-type forest fire tower. The register gives a 65-foot steel tower. The story gives both; height_m uses the register's 65 ft (19.8 m).

The Quaker Hill register says the tower was re-erected on High School Hill in Tiverton but gives no date. The Tiverton register gives 1964 as the build year. The 1963 notice authorized relocation to that site. Read together, 1964 probably marks the re-erection, but no source says so.

notes_for_editor: Construction start (October 1934), first operation (1937) and removal (1963) come from the Forest Lookouts newspaper clippings and the register. The clippings give the start of construction, not its finish. Height conflict (60 ft stairway in 1934, 65 ft in the register) is recorded, not resolved. The agency value 'Sub' looks like a parse of a district label; the correction is proposed from the 1950 notice, which is the only source naming the state division. The Tiverton relocation and the 1964 date are linked by inference, not by a source that says so. No source describes the Portsmouth site now. Coordinates differ between the register (41.5865, -71.25367) and the FFLA list (41.58401, -71.25457), about 290 m apart by my calculation from those two pairs; the story does not place the site precisely. A Facebook group post titled North Brayton Road Fire Tower appeared in search results but could not be fetched and is not used. No photos added.
